title: Microsoft Copilot: Copilot edits on a Page are highlighted by default
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's planned default-on highlighting and the documented Pages controls and requirements. The creation policy establishes availability, not actual usage, so the user-identification advice needs narrowing. Two minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting storage documentation and name the API's deciding property in its table note.
